description:
Upgrade your operating system. CYBER TECH – the Syndicate Collection – merges cyberpunk aesthetics with ergonomic engineering in three distinct pieces.

The lineup

The Core Node – a long shaft dildo built for deep exploration, with a stable suction cup base for hands-free mounting.

The Matrix Root – a knot dildo with a pronounced, textured knot and a secure suction cup base for a deeply fulfilling, locked-in sensation.

The Sub-Net – a snug-fitting cock knot wearable for a secure, locked-in feel during dynamic play. Insert your floppy for the latest firmware updates.

Explore Cyber Tech in 3D

Spin it, switch between the three pieces, slide the diameter ring to measure it at any point, compare it with a soda or Monster can, and tap the AR button on your phone to see it at real size in your room.

Make it yours

Pick your toy and density, then list one or two colours and/or glitters (the colour charts are in the gallery). No colours listed? We'll choose a stunning combination for you. Made to order – ships in 2–5 business days in plain, unmarked packaging.

sections.title: Materials & Colours
sections.html:
Every Syndicate piece is handmade in Australia from high-grade, skin-safe, soft-touch silicone (choose soft or ultra soft). All our silicone toys are Australian Made Certified.

Colours: list one or two colours and/or glitters when you order – see the colour charts in the gallery. The charts are a reference guide only: colours shift once mixed into silicone, and every pour is unique. If no colours are listed, we'll select a stunning combination for you.

sections.title: Ways to Play
sections.html:
Core Node: deep, hands-free riding on its suction cup base.

Matrix Root: stationary play with a locked-in knot.

Sub-Net: wear it for stamina and a secure, knotted feel with a partner.
